scope: Chromium synthetic procedural 20-actor renderer; not authenticated gameplay, native packaged assets, physical Android, final-art or full starter-catalog qualification
percentile: nearest rank: sorted[ceil(n*0.75)-1]; no trimming, retries or discarded slow samples
networkUnits: CDP latency milliseconds and throughput bytes/second; gzip HTTP bodies and exact lengths, loopback only
cold: Fresh isolated browser context per pair, service workers blocked, CDP clearBrowserCache then cache enabled; fresh document and renderer, not a cold OS/browser/GPU process
warm: One normal page.reload in the same context immediately after cold; HTTP cache enabled, no clearing; require positive asset cache evidence
ready: Navigation start to 20 synthetic actors rendered through two RAF callbacks; initial quality selected before any renderer construction
art: No separately downloaded final art in this procedural fixture; resource transfer sizes are reported but final art wait and 8/24MiB catalog qualification remain NOT_QUALIFIED

heap.protocol: Separate unthrottled same-profile context. Active 20-actor warm baseline and each active recreate sample use external HeapProfiler.collectGarbage twice with 1000ms idle between, then Runtime.getHeapUsage. Final active usedSize minus warm active usedSize compared to max(16MiB,20% baseline). Missing GC/heap evidence fails; stopped zero-lease/canvas plus post-stop heap reported separately. Not driver/native RSS or authenticated travel.

changePolicy: Keep v1 and all failures; never edit original thresholds or this profile after measurement. A different protocol needs a separately versioned profile.
